snippet.title: DBP75: Patagonian Pilgrimage - Showcase
snippet.description:
DBP75: Patagonian Pilgrimage is a sixteen-map Doom II megawad for limit-removing source ports created by the fine folks at Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz, to keep you cool during these hot summer days. It is loosely inspired by the Patagonia region in South America. It is the 75th installment in the ongoing Doomer Boards Project series and released on August 1st, 2025.

You can get the project at:
https://doomer.boards.net/thread/4082/patagonian-pilgrimage-dbp75
https://www.moddb.com/mods/dbp75-patagonian-pilgrimage

MAPLIST:
00:00 - MAP01: "Alpaca Summit" by 40oz
00:36 - MAP02: "Tribute to Mr. Hands" by joe-ilya
01:12 - MAP03: "Caribou Crossing" by 40oz
01:43 - MAP04: "Land of Fire" by Mayhem
02:21 - MAP05: "Hell's Overpass" by TheHockster
03:01 - MAP06: "Forgeward" by ClumsyCryptid
03:42 - MAP07: "Second Nature" by joe-ilya
04:25 - MAP08: "Emberstone Fortress" by J-Force
05:23 - MAP09: "Xanadu" by gije
06:14 - MAP10: "Linkorn Park" by joe-ilya
07:13 - MAP11: "Patagonia Experiment" by thundercunt
08:15 - MAP12: "Twilight Ascetic" by Gru
09:18 - MAP13: "Cozy Mansion" by joe-ilya
10:29 - MAP14: "Global Warming" by joe-ilya
11:21 - MAP15: "Hotel Patagonia" by Nockson
12:35 - MAP16: "Patagonian Pilgrimage" by 40oz

13:07 - Doomer Boards will return...
